title: Looks like an oversized “moo moo” and pocket is too low but it’s very warm and cozy
text:
Looks like an oversized “moo moo” and pocket is too low but it’s very warm and cozy. The current price of $37.19 ($39.99 minus 7%) is about $8 too much for this in my opinion. I love how plush this is and how warm and cozy it feels. However, I am 5'5" tall and I find it hard to reach the kangaroo pocket comfortably. Unfortunately, none of my cats will stay in the pouch which has an opening on top and either side. See photo with my cat's head sticking out; he jumped out immediately. This also drapes over the body like a moo moo and is highly unattractive--at least on me. The bottom is so wide and the top is more narrow.

I would not put this in the dryer after washing this because this is the type of material that will burn.

If the pocket was easily reachable and the bottom was not so super wide with such a narrow top, then this would have received 5 stars from me at the current price.
